description: Single and two storey side to rear extension; alterations to roof to form end gable and rear dormer; external alterations
decision_conditions: <p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">The proposed two storey side and rear&nbsp;extension’s roof form in conjunction with the rear dormer by reason of its poor design would create a poorly conceived, incongruous and contrived form of development that fails to appropriately relate or respond to the original dwellinghouse. The proposal would give rise to a disproportionate addition which would fail to provide a coherent pattern of development in the street scene, and would therefore unduly harm the form and proportion of the site and relationship with the properties in the locality. The proposal would be unduly harmful to the character and appearance of the original dwellinghouse and the visual amenities of the area, contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 D(1) and D(11) of The London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1.B of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 of the Development Management Plan Local Policies (2013) and the Adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</span></span></p>
